Universal identity relies on the exact finite-degree polynomial certificate and combinatorial proof, not this finite prefix.
residual_risks: Individual certificate polynomial identities were inspected as exact claims but full independent execution of that verifier was not used as a separate proof; finite recurrence checks alone do not prove all k.
